name: @ruah-dev/app
description: Ruah maps any codebase into a living architecture and lets coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, Kiro, OpenCode) work on it — a local-first macOS desktop app, daemon and CLI.
author: Ruah contributors (https://github.com/ruah-dev)

scripts.build: tsup src/cli.ts --format esm --target node22 --clean && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.ui:build: cd ui && bun run build && cd .. && rm -rf viewer && cp -R ui/.output/public viewer
scripts.app: pnpm build && pnpm ui:build && pnpm desktop
scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm ui:build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:app: pnpm build && pnpm ui:build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs

ruah.description: Ruah desktop app: architecture map + coding agents (`ruah app` opens it)
